slides.texte_overlay:
How to brutally transform
your life.

1. Kill the comfortable routine.

Same breakfast, same feed,
same excuses. Change one thing
every week.

2. Do the thing you're avoiding first.

The call, the workout, the email.
The rest of the day gets lighter.

3. Make your body a project.

Three workouts a week.
Track them. Beat last week.

4. Make your mind a project.

One book, one skill, one idea a day.
Growth needs fuel.
